outcome: actual EBF practices at 1 month, 3 months, and 6 months
cohort: 171 women admitted for elective cesarean delivery in Kelantan
finding: Women who intended to practice EBF for 6 months were more likely to actually do so, but overall EBF rates decreased over time after delivery.
mod_finding: While not explicitly comparing modes of delivery, the study found that the number of women who practiced exclusive breastfeeding after cesarean delivery was lower than those who intended to prenatally.
